user_saw: New SQLite work could fail with “SQLite worker store capacity reached” while idle shared-state handles still held broker reservations.
summary: The broker can reclaim an owner-confirmed idle shared-state client at the 64-client limit and use the released reservation for a new open.
reasoning: I checked #144871, which introduced the broker and explicitly documented that it rejects new opens when 64 clients are opening or live. #145851 added a shared-state owner that cached open clients across operations, allowing idle handles to consume those reservations. #151581 later added timed idle retirement, which still left new opens subject to rejection before the timer fired.
